name: FSport AB (publ)
summary: Founded in Helsingborg, Sweden, in 2013, FSport AB (publ) is a gaming platform enterprise. The company specializes in delivering mobile sports games and facilitates sports betting services through its proprietary platform. FSport also oversees the 1X2.se and Trav.se online portals, which aim to inform and engage a community of sports and gaming enthusiasts within the iGaming industry.
